command_note: Equivalent repo-relative command; local command invocation is recorded by the runner.
conclusion_boundary: All four prespecified arms are reported, not a post-hoc test-selected mechanism proof. This small exposed-test pilot cannot establish substantive innovation or an independent confirmatory effect.

definitions.attack_family_macro_recall: Mean exact-class recall over attack classes.
definitions.binary_attack_macro_recall: Mean across true attack classes of P(predicted non-Normal | that true class).
definitions.binary_attack_micro_recall: All true attacks predicted as any attack / all true attacks.
definitions.confusion_counts: predicted_normal_count=CM[c,Normal]; other_attack_count=sum CM[c,k] for k neither Normal nor c. For rare attacks these partition errors; correct-family count is true_positive.
definitions.cost: Real steps, memory and exposures matched, NOT equal FLOPs. Row touches are not FLOPs. Recorded components exclude data loading, some final serialization, and unrecorded failed-attempt work; no complete wall-cost claim.
definitions.gradient_proxy: Extra CE/margin logit-gradient L2 sums are not parameter-gradient norms or matched objective scale.
definitions.old_new: Unweighted exact-class recall means over tasks0-2 and task3 respectively; not a forgetting score.
definitions.paired: 100*(arm-random), same dataset/seed; lower Normal FPR is better, higher other rates is better. Undefined precision remains null, never zero-filled.
definitions.rates: Fractions; summaries use per-seed mean and sample SD (ddof=1), n=2; no confidence or significance inference.

payload_verification: Actual 16 final and 4 common-prefix local PT hashes, identities, final audits/schedules and resident memory checked. No inference rerun.
scope: All 16 cells, two already-exposed seeds per dataset, all four arms; no test-driven selection, formal confirmation, causal mechanism, novelty, RQ1/RQ3 or overall closure claim.
